race.comment: KENNY'S SWANS (3) resumes and his local form is compelling. Knocked off his maiden over TIME FOR SNOW after only missing by a head here the run prior. Drawn sticky but looks a progressive type and gets a key booking in Heywood. Can return with a bang. TIME FOR SNOW (5) won first-up at Moruya as a well-supported favourite and has placed at both attempts here. The rise to 1200m is no concern. Can make it two on the bounce. VINARI (6) resumed with a decisive Queanbeyan win 11 days ago when sent forward and stretching out nicely in the lane. She is proven at 1200m and is drawn kinder this time. Warrants plenty of respect. SERENADING (2) was beaten as favourite here first-up on heavy ground and must answer the extra-distance question after showing plenty of promise early in her career. Not underestimating. SEASMOKE (11) will appreciate dropping back to this level and gets a key booking in Boudvillain, who'll need to be on top of his game from out there. Keeping safe.
